name: Vesicular-Tempest
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in orbital debris ring. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Instruments disagree about radiation hotspot: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on rare flora and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
